what: On first open, a big number on a gray curtain climbs by 1~10 every 50~250ms until it reaches 100 (the text line below flows once around in 25s). After .3s the number and text line slide up 60% and vanish (.8s power3.inOut). .25s before that ends, two curtains whose bottom edges bow like arcs (gray · background color) lift upward over 1s expo.inOut, the second one .12s later, sagging 18% in the middle at mid-lift. At .35s into the lift fx:reveal fires (Hero opens), and fx:done fires when it ends

options.dur: Time for one curtain to lift (sec), default 1
options.out: Length for number and text lines to slide out (seconds), default .8
options.bow: Depth at which the curtain’s lower edge sags (% of screen height), default 18 — 0 gives a straight curtain
options.loop: Time for one loop of the text line (sec), default 25 — 0 stops it
options.count: When off, skips the count and clears right away (for screens opened often, like an app)
options.lock: If off, the page still scrolls while the cover is down
options.[data-fx-part=count]: Counting digit slot (if empty, it starts right away)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Text line flowing downward (store name, etc., optional)
options.--fx-curtain · --fx-curtain-ink: Top curtain color (default text color 16.7% + background) · number and text color (default background darkened by .785x)
options.fx:reveal · fx:done: Event raised from the element — hook the Hero photo opening and header entrance here

from.where: shared.js loader — counter → two curved cover layers (#555 and #333) · shop name marquee below · mvshow stage (fx:reveal)
